name: personal-assistant
description: AI Executive Personal Assistant for Email and WhatsApp
author: Personal Assistant

scripts.electron:dev: cross-env DESKTOP_MODE=true NEXT_PUBLIC_DESKTOP_MODE=true concurrently -k -n "NEXT,DESKTOP" -c "cyan,magenta" "next dev -p 3000" "wait-on -t 30000 http://localhost:3000 && electron ."
scripts.dist:win: cross-env DESKTOP_MODE=true NEXT_PUBLIC_DESKTOP_MODE=true next build && node scripts/prepare_standalone.mjs && electron-builder --win
scripts.dist:mac: cross-env DESKTOP_MODE=true NEXT_PUBLIC_DESKTOP_MODE=true next build && node scripts/prepare_standalone.mjs && electron-builder --mac
scripts.dist:all: cross-env DESKTOP_MODE=true NEXT_PUBLIC_DESKTOP_MODE=true next build && node scripts/prepare_standalone.mjs && electron-builder -mw
